entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is absolutely unacceptable, and I want my money back now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the wrong color! My wife said it looks ridiculous. Are you kidding me with this service? I'm not wearing it, the box is unopened, and I want to send it back. If you give me any trouble, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. Get me your manager.
I understand your frustration, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Getting the right gear is essential for both comfort and safety. Let me just pull up your order.
You'd better. This is a waste of my time.
Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the helmet was delivered 9 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return, so you are well within the timeframe.
Wait, really? That's it? You're just going to take it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened and it's well within the 90-day window, I can approve this return immediately. I'm generating a pre-paid return label for you right now, and it should be in your email inbox in the next few minutes.
Oh. Wow. Okay, well... that was easier than I expected. Sorry for getting so angry. I just had a bad experience with another company last week.

I completely understand. No problem at all. We want to make sure you're happy with your VeloFit gear. Once we receive the return, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks, Isaac. I appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Have a great day!
